class.name: VirtualJoystick
class.description: [VirtualJoystick] is a GUI control that simulates an analog stick. It can be set to fixed, dynamic (appears where touched), or following modes. It emits [InputEventVirtualMotion] events for axes 0 (X) and 1 (Y).

method.name: get_output
method.description: Returns the current normalized output vector of the joystick.

members.member: The radius in pixels within which the joystick handle can move. In [code]JOYSTICK_MODE_FIXED[/code], this radius is automatically derived from the node's size and this property is ignored for drawing.
The radius in pixels of the center deadzone. Movement within this zone is ignored.
The behavior mode of the joystick.

constants.constant: The joystick remains in a fixed position.
The joystick appears at the position where the screen is touched.
The joystick base follows the finger dragging it if it goes beyond the clamp zone.

theme_items.theme_item: Modulate color for the joystick base.
Modulate color for the joystick tip (handle).
